crossRefs.note: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,

The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer…
Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you…
Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded…

You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
“As I live,” says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies, “surely like Tabor among the mountains, and like Carmel by…

people.name: Abinoam
people.line: Father of Barak, the Israelite commander

people.name: Barak
people.line: An Israelite commander who defeated Canaanite forces with Deborah.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Kedesh
people.line: A Canaanite city, later a Levitical city of refuge in Naphtali

people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

people.name: Tabor_Mount
people.line: Mountain in Israel, site of Deborah and Barak's victory

people.name: Zebulun
people.line: Israelite tribe, son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: She sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh Naphtali, and said to him, “Hasn’t Yahweh, the God of Israel, commanded, ‘Go and lead the way to Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
translations.bsb: She summoned Barak son of Abinoam from Kedesh in Naphtali and said to him, “Surely the LORD, the God of Israel, is commanding you: ‘Go and march to Mount Tabor, taking with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun.
translations.kjv: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedeshnaphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the LORD God of Israel commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
translations.asv: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh-naphtali, and said unto him, Hath not Jehovah, the God of Israel, commanded, saying, Go and draw unto mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
